A Nightmare Knight, on his way to the Knightwatch Tower, fell into a hole in the Plains of Havoc and was killed by a {creature:Giant Spider}. In the spider's lair you find his remains: 5 {item:Power Bolt|Power Bolts}, 12 {item:Burst Arrow|Burst Arrows}, a {item:Two Handed Sword} and the book {item:The Dreammaster (Book)}, plus {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars} and a {item:Talon} that respawn every day.
A Nightmare Knight, on his way to the Knightwatch Tower, fell into a hole and died at the hands of a Giant Spider.
Hole south of the Plains of Havoc temple
No minimum level (40+ recommended, because of the Giant Spider).
The {creature:Giant Spider} poisons and hits hard for low levels: bring potions and poison cures.

Across the Plains of Havoc there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons}, {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers} and an {creature:Orc Leader}.
Get to the Plains of Havoc
The {wiki:Plains of Havoc} are **southwest** of **Venore** (and southeast of Kazordoon). Leave Venore and head southwest to the Plains of Havoc temple (number 1 on the map), where {npc:Oldrak} is.
Go to the **Plains of Havoc** and enter the hole right **south** of the temple. Use the {item:Shovel} if the hole is covered.
Hole south of the Plains of Havoc temple
Down there is a {creature:Giant Spider}. Kill it before you look for the treasure.
The Giant Spider is dangerous for low levels (poison and strong attacks).
Hidden under several corpses there are two human bodies and a {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|pile of bones}. Keep moving/opening the corpses until you find them.
Open the human body that is **right under the teleport**: it has the book {item:The Dreammaster (Book)}.
Open the corpses to get the reward
Open the human body on the **north** side: it has a {item:Brown Bag} with 5 {item:Power Bolt|Power Bolts} and 12 {item:Burst Arrow|Burst Arrows}.
Open the {item:Pile of Bones (Quest)|pile of bones}: it has the {item:Two Handed Sword}.
On the **east** side of the room there is a {wiki:Daily respawn|daily respawn} of 6 {item:Throwing Star|Throwing Stars}, and in the **southwest** corner another one with a {item:Talon}. Pick them up.

To leave, go back to the spot where you fell and use the {item:Rope} to climb out through the hole. You end up **south** of the Plains of Havoc temple again; from there go back to **Venore**, to the **northeast**.
